prompt:
Design brief — your own take on this character. A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult woman — the personification of the element Gold (금) itself — the sovereign of the Gold Nation. A female character who IS the element; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the element’s traits. Age: early thirties — a poised, mature face with defined cheekbones and jaw; at most faint lines, no deep folds or under-eye bags.

You design her yourself: invent her face, eye colour, hairstyle, makeup, expression, pose and setting as a fresh, original take — do not follow any earlier design of this character. Her hair colour and costume are NOT free: take them from our designs below.

Style (fixed): A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish.

Inspiration only — her element: warm yellow gold with deep amber shadow, hammered gold leaf and embossed relief, fine stamped borders, permanence shown as an unchanging polish; the element of wealth, permanence and light. Palette: yellow gold, amber, electrum pale, deep red velvet.

World (fixed): around 1849, a gold-rush town: a mine stamp mill and water wheel, brass assay scales, a bank vault with a brass dial, dust and lamplight. Her costume and setting belong to this world.

Costume (choose one of ours, then add your own idea): pick ONE of these costume shapes from our set and keep its overall silhouette — 1) a fitted bodice and a long bustled ball gown sweeping out behind her, long gloves — an elegant, wide-trailing shape; 2) a long tailcoat over a waistcoat, a small silk top hat and a pocket-watch chain — a gentleman inventor's upright shape; 3) a double-breasted military greatcoat below the knee with brass buttons and epaulettes, tall boots — an angular, commanding shape; 4) an open crinoline cage of brass hoops below the waist under a sheer overskirt — a birdcage-wide shape. Then add one signature idea of your own drawn from her element, built into the construction of the outfit itself rather than as a print or a loose accessory — e.g. plates or cloth layered like crystals, scales or flames, a hem or sleeve cut into a shape from her element. Build it in this world's materials and our colours below.

Costume colours (ours): yellow gold, amber, electrum pale, deep red velvet.

Hair colour (fixed — ours): golden blonde hair. Keep exactly this hair colour; only the hairstyle is yours.

Exposure (fixed): bold — her outfit shows skin by design (a deep neckline, bare shoulders or arms, a high slit or short hem); intimate areas covered.

Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin — never a long face or a long, pointed or heavy jaw; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline and never lengthens her face. Her eyes stay at a natural open size — never squeezed into narrow slits.

Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

If you have already drawn a free design of her in this session, make this one clearly different — another face and hairstyle (the same hair colour), another costume shape with another signature idea, another pose and setting.

Write your own detailed image prompt from this brief, then draw it. One figure only, natural hands with five fingers; no text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (Au) and atomic number (79) — and those only as part of the scene: engraved, embroidered or glowing on her costume, a banner, a sign or a machine, never as a floating label, corner badge, periodic-table tile, caption or overlay on the picture; no logo or watermark.

Detailed original design for this image:
Choose silhouette 1: fitted low-neck gold silk bodice and a sweeping bustled deep-red velvet ball gown with a high front-side slit, long electrum satin gloves, laced boots. Signature construction: very thin hammered-gold leaf fan pleats physically stiffen the bustle into a radiating assay-sun shape. Golden-blonde hair in a softly curled shoulder-length bob, violet eyes, compact oval adult face, knowing small smile. Both hands empty and visible, one touching the waist seam, one relaxed outward. Setting: gaslit bank vault entrance with large unnumbered brass dial and steam pipes, warm amber light.
acceptance: user selected worlds 1,3,2; commit and normal main update authorized
